uhc.text: Prostate test (PSA) prices for UnitedHealthcare commercial (employer or individual) plans range from $11.03 to $32.18 across 28 hospitals. Most prices fall between $16.55 and $32.18, with the highest price 2.9 times the lowest.

bcbs_az.text: A prostate test (PSA) billed to Blue Cross Blue Shield of Arizona commercial plans has a lowest price of $36.78 and a highest price of $107, which is 2.9 times the lowest. The median price is $49.83.

aetna.text: Prostate test (PSA) for Aetna commercial (employer or individual) plans has hospital prices ranging from $18.31 to $95.37. Most prices fall between $18.31 and $68.26, and the highest price is 5.2 times the lowest.

cigna.text: Prostate test (PSA) prices for Cigna commercial plans range from $13.25 to $224 across 30 hospitals. The highest price is 16.9 times the lowest. Most prices fall between $28.22 and $224.

humana.text: Prostate test (PSA) prices for Humana commercial (employer or individual) plans are $62.16 at 5 HonorHealth hospitals and $64.46 at 3 Abrazo Health (Tenet) hospitals. The median price is $62.16, and most prices fall between $62.16 and $64.46.

cash.text: The cash price for a Prostate test (PSA) ranges from $4.70 to $382 across hospitals. Most prices fall between $8.14 and $382, and the median price is $21.15. The highest price is 81.3 times the lowest price, and 64% of cash prices are below typical insured prices.
